'''Magnetic fault sensors''' were a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]. They could be used to detect flaws and weaknesses in an [[Magnetic field/Legends|atmosphere containment field]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] used [[R4 astromech droid/Legends|R4 astromech droids]] rigged with magnetic fault sensors to find any such weakness in the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star's]] atmosphere containment fields.<ref name="EGTD" />
